topology_reasoning.device_interpretation: A three-guide grating-assisted coupler/filter: one straight central bus lies between two routed U-shaped access guides. Each outer guide has an inward-facing periodic grating section adjacent to the bus, then routes around a large-radius bend to a tapered outer port. The two outer guides are vertically mirrored in the drawing, while their routing directions are opposite.
topology_reasoning.operation: The periodic teeth bring the outer guide mode close to the central bus over a long interaction region and provide phase-matched, distributed coupling. The long U-shaped access paths keep the external ports separated from the coupling region and the tapers transition to the narrow image-defined ports.
topology_reasoning.geometry_observations: The drawing has a 18.24 um horizontal footprint and a 0.7 um vertical footprint. The central bus is a uniform horizontal rectangle. The upper outer guide approaches the coupling region from the left, runs through the upper grating, turns upward at the right, and exits through a broad upper taper toward the left. The lower outer guide is the vertical mirror: it enters the lower grating from the left, turns downward at the left, and exits through a broad lower taper toward the right. Black grating teeth are repeated uniformly along the inner edge of each outer guide.

iterations.change_made: Initial primitives-only assembly: three routed guide groups, central bus, two 56-tooth arrays, tapers, and sampled U-turns.

Aligned the grating pitch and start, shortened the long upper body, moved the lower taper base, and replaced the lower-right bend with measured intermediate centerline points.
Trial vertical re-registration and curve-control changes; the score regressed, so this candidate was discarded.
